posts.text:
rambling, unmoored and unserious. 
in way over his head.

us allies deeply concerned by the 19 minute iran speech from the commander in chief.
trump speech absolutely not what markets were hoping for.

zero talk of us-iran negotiations so far. 

all about unilateral military strikes/solution.

next 2-3 weeks, we will hit iran extremely hard, bomb them back to the stone ages. 

key quote that moves markets so far.

trump says there would be no israel right now if he had not terminated the obama iran deal. 

big if true. 
granted, not true. 
but big if true.

obama giving iran so much cash.

though much less that iran now making with us suspended sanctions on oil.

“we’re now totally independent from the middle east.” 

would be nice to see a better understanding of interdependence and the global marketplace.
trump speech opens with congrats/nod to artemis. good.

it is extraordinary that instead of celebrating america’s engineering prowess at the artemis launch, president trump is tilting at windmills at an idiotic case that never should have reached the supreme court.
of note: then senator marco rubio sponsored the bill to block nato pullout
no, they’re just a threat to my democracy.

yes! moose for president! very excited about this.

impossible to imagine. like maga types supporting biden. 

on the other hand, i was extremely positive about trump win in venezuela. and extremely negative about biden debacle in afghanistan. 

sadly trump decisionmaking on iran has been kinda fucked, to use the technical term.
i’m trying to imagine a trucker in iowa thinking “i don’t mind paying way more for gas now that the iranian navy has been damaged.”

trump isn’t just seeking an off-ramp, he’s seeking a win.

Video

my two cents on president trump speech tonight:

gas over $4 
popularity under 40 
thousands of troops sent to the region 

he’ll try to explain why the sacrifice is small and worth it. and how the united states has already basically won. 

i’d be surprised with any concrete breakthrough with iranians.
